body:
Thanks for the quick feedback. I use the official Linux binaries. I did a quick grep but I could not find a plugin that has a ReadCommand for the Extension "heic":

```
$ grep ReadCommand imageio/*.txt
imageio/avifhdr.txt:Extension=avif

imageio/avif.txt:Extension=avif
imageio/avif.txt:ReadCommand=python hif/heif_io.py

imageio/exrdwab.txt:Extension=exr

imageio/exr.txt:Extension=exr
imageio/exr.txt:ReadCommand=python exr/exr_io.py --mode read

imageio/fits.txt:Extension=fit
imageio/fits.txt:ReadCommand=python fits/fits_load.py

imageio/heifhdr.txt:Extension=heic

imageio/heifsdr.txt:Extension=heic

imageio/hif.txt:Extension=hif
imageio/hif.txt:ReadCommand=python hif/heif_io.py

imageio/jxlhdr.txt:Extension=jxl

imageio/jxl.txt:Extension=jxl
imageio/jxl.txt:ReadCommand=python jxl/jxl_io.py --mode read

imageio/ultrahdr.txt:Extension=jpg

imageio/webp.txt:Extension=webp
imageio/webp.txt:ReadCommand=python webp/webp_io.py -m read```
```

Another question is what python installation is used. The one from the system? It means I have to install all required Python dependencies system wide? What kind of feedback do I get if the plugin is not working, e.g. because of missing dependencies?
